text: Remember that laws of supply and demand are key concepts in economics related to how goods are produced and consumed based on price changes. Think about what producers might want when prices go up!

Consider what happens to producer behavior when prices increase according to economic principles of supply and demand. Think about how this relates to their incentive to produce more or less based on potential profit margins. What is typically observed? (Hint: It's a positive relationship between price and quantity supplied.)

The Law of Supply suggests an increase in production as prices rise; think about producers' motivation to sell more when they can earn higher profits. Now, considering this principle, which option best completes your statement? A) Less B) More C) The same amount D) An unpredictable amount
